name: Test Cards
description: Generate payment test card data that follows issuer ranges and Luhn, validate card numbers and look up sourced official sandbox cards
help: Locally generated numbers only follow issuer ranges, lengths and Luhn for form and format testing; they are not issued cards nor sandbox cards of any payment platform.
For payment integration use the official sandbox cards with that platform's test keys; they come from official docs with their source and verification date.
A seed makes results reproducible (expiry dates are relative to the current month); CSV / JSON exports are tagged test-only and local-format.
Validation only infers the brand from number ranges; passing Luhn does not mean a card exists, can pay or will be accepted.
notice: For development testing only: these numbers cannot be used for real payments.
